proof_roadmap.step: Apply Lemma ML-local to get the Mittag-Leffler condition
Replace (H^i_m(M_n)) by the systems of images (E_n) with surjective transitions and H^i_m(M) = lim E_n
Apply Lemma descending-chain: only finitely many nontrivial kernels, hence E_n -> E_{n-1} is an isomorphism for n >> 0
